title: Autotiler: admin macro orchestration for incremental remediations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an 'Autotiler' orchestration layer that composes existing runbook snippets and admin utilities into idempotent, auditable macros that can be executed as incremental remediations. The goal is to enable first-line engineers to apply small, safe fixes (tile-by-tile) with built-in telemetry, automatic dry-run evaluation, and audit logging. Autotiler should 1) stitch typed runbook fragments into a single executable macro, 2) wrap each step with safety decorators (dry-run, guardrails, undo tokens), 3) surface telemetry/expected impact before execution, and 4) provide a canary/rollout primitive to apply changes progressively across target sets.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: aligned with PM (Ravi Chen) and Support leads. We scoped MVP to three use-cases: database connection reset, ingress route rebind, and temporary feature flag flip. Agreed to reuse typed fragment schema from ENG-951357 for inputs.

2026-03-05 - Design sync: decided on explicit 'tile' contract: inputs, idempotency token, estimated blast radius, dry-run validator. Trade-off: using existing snippet DSL vs introducing new macro DSL. Opted to adapt existing DSL to avoid fragmentation.

2026-03-07 - Spike complete: prototype composer that merges three fragments and injects pre/post hooks. Observed ~8% latency overhead for preflight telemetry calls; acceptable for targeted remediations. Spike code: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autotiler/spike-merge (internal)

2026-03-09 - Security review request opened (SRE security triage). Initial feedback: require KMS-backed undo tokens and stricter audit fields. Created ticket ENG-271444 as an upstream dependency for audit schema alignment.

2026-03-11 - PR opened for macro runtime and safety decorators: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autotiler/pull/23. Engineering review from Priya (runtime) flagged race condition with concurrent undo tokens; patch in progress.
2026-03-13 - QA note: added deterministic dry-run mode so tests can assert idempotency without mutating state. Integration tests added to ephemeral sandbox cluster (k8s-ops-sim).
2026-03-14 - PM feedback: Add an explicit 'preview UI hook' so Console can render expected token/cost and blast radius. Filed follow-up PM sub-task ENG-964204.

2026-03-15 - Blocker resolved: fixed undo token race by moving token minting to a single-controller transaction. Re-running end-to-end on staging. Next: schedule canary rollout with observability thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Compose at least three typed runbook fragments into a single executable macro with a documented tile contract.
Every macro execution must support dry-run, produce a preflight telemetry report, and write an auditable execution record to the ops ledger.
Safety decorators: undo token issuance, blast-radius estimation, and automatic abort if post-checks fail.
Integration test suite demonstrates idempotency for the three MVP use-cases in the ephemeral sandbox.
Console preview hook implemented and basic UI integration tested by DevEx with a mock preview endpoint.
Security review sign-off (security_review_required = true) and KMS-backed undo tokens enabled before rollout.
Canary rollout plan documented and validated with SLO thresholds and rollback steps.
